name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (battle/spell cast domain). Accurately reflects purpose: casts the speed/Haste buff spell (effect id 0x13, 風行術). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix).
purpose: Battle spell worker that applies the speed-boost ('Haste' / 風行術, effect id 0x13) buff to each targeted unit.
logic_summary: Plays per-target impact + status-overlay-flicker animations (id 0x13). For each target id in the byte array: compute level_mod = unit.status_flags_block[0] (level byte), +0x1E if job_id is an intermediate class (9..0x18). If the unit's dx-buff timer status_flags_block[3]==0 (not yet boosted): advance RNG and set timer = (rng_return % 4) + 2 turns, add flat +0xF to dx_current and +0xF to stat4_current (evade), draw +15 as a heal-style number (glyph 0x69='i'), credit level_mod*2 pending XP. Else (already boosted): draw miss indicator, no stacking. Closes with fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). Flat +15 buff with no FPU scaling, unlike the AP/DP boost siblings.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 num_targets, uint32 target_id_array)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Caster unit index; forwarded to the impact/overlay animation calls. Callers (dispatch wrapper, summon combo, item-effect dispatch) pass the casting unit.

params.name: num_targets
params.semantics: Number of targets; loop bound for the per-target apply loop (iter < num_targets).

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Base address of a byte array of target unit ids, indexed per iteration as ((uint8 *)target_id_array)[iter], matching asm *(byte *)(param_3 + iVar5). Keeps the original Ghidra uint address contract.
params.reason: Accurate; uint address contract documented in comment, no residue.

notes: Verified against disassembly: timer = (rng_return % 4) + 2 uses fd2_advance_rng_state EAX return (0x22A30 CALL / 0x22A35 MOV EDX,EAX / SAR 0x1f / IDIV EBX=4 / ADD 0x2 / MOV [ESI+0x24],DL), NOT the __CHK probe return that the raw Ghidra decompiler mis-attributed; the source comment already documents this EAX-bug correction correctly. Flat +0xF buffs at 0x22A47 ([ESI+0x4c]=dx_current) and 0x22A4C ([ESI+0x4e]=stat4_current/evade) confirmed. Struct offsets match types.h: job_id +0x20, status_flags_block[0] +0x21, status_flags_block[3] (dx_buff) +0x24, dx_current +0x4C, stat4_current +0x4E. Source comment block (lines 830-882) is precise, ASCII, and fully consistent with asm + plate; no edit needed. Ghidra plate consistent with refined understanding; no update needed. No logic/equivalence issues found.
